item.title: All AI-generated code should be Open Source
item.description:
📝 This may be a hot take, but I strongly believe that all code generated by AI should be Open Source. Turning this collective knowledge into proprietary, closed-source code feels like license laundering. Code like this, where humans put little effort, except writing prompts, should definitely be Open Source.
🔗 Read more: https://jakub.jankiewicz.org/blog/ai-code-open-source/
